_source: Shape from https://developers.soundcharts.com/openapi.json, GET /api/v2.25/song/by-isrc/{isrc}, 200 SongResponse3 { type, object: Song3, errors }; Song3 fields uuid, name, isrc (Isrc: value, countryCode, countryName), creditName, artists and mainArtists (ArtistLight: uuid, slug, name, appUrl, imageUrl), releaseDate. The uuid and ISRC are the reference's own examples; the names are test values. Never seen from the live API.
